_comment: Row 355. Re-run from a detached standalone scratch clone: toolchain/bin/bd-mutate --spec tests/mutants/row355_mutate_timing_is_schedule_stable.json --work SCRATCH --timeout 300. The five regressions restore the bare zero-row IndexError, replace measured timeout derivation with the old literal, falsely rewrite the successful negative control as a timeout, corrupt the restored subject after timeout, and retain JUnit residue. Every catcher drives the behavioral seam and asserts its preconditions before its verdict.
subject: bd-mutate timeout tests diagnose zero rows and derive a schedule-stable timeout while preserving negative, restoration, and JUnit controls
